Its website says it is the bargaining representative for Oakland Unified School District administrators, matching the agenda's side letters, MOUs and tentative agreements between OUSD and UAOS

research.notes: Tax-exempt labor organization (IRS 501(c)(5)), not a charity; orgType set to 'other'. No general email found on the contact page. Third-party directories list a different phone number (510-635-9222); the organization's own site number was used.

profile.summary: A labor union (Local 83 of the American Federation of School Administrators) that represents administrators of the Oakland Unified School District, such as principals, assistant principals, directors, coordinators and business managers. It provides representation, guidance and collective bargaining for its members.
